title: Snowdrop: the low tide near the Aquarium entrance hall
summary: Snowdrop saw the low tide near the Aquarium entrance hall this week (fiction).
body:
I found curled leaves by the Aquarium entrance hall after the dip. Not many. The grow-lamps there flickered twice, then held. If you pass by, look at the planters near the door and tell me if they look thirsty or only tired.

Fiction: a story notice from the city of Noctiluca. Not a real event, and nothing here was measured.
